relation_replay_kept.note: fires on the failing test's OWN input literals on the patched build (deterministic, 2/2 replays); fuzzed: 20000/20000
relation_replay_kept.why:
The fired check asserts that on an `ObjectList` containing no stored null, `indexOf(null)` must complete and return `-1`, and that is supported by the shown contract and implementation of `AbstractObjectList#indexOf`, so a correct implementation could not legitimately throw the observed `IllegalArgumentException` here.
CITATION: NONE
